text:
Nina K (cs-ops): Noticing an odd pattern in the health_score pipeline for trials created 2024-10-28..2024-11-02. Scores are zeroed out instead of null which is causing the renewals model to underweight these cohorts. Can data and eng help triage? :mag:
Eli P (data): I can look. Quick check: are we seeing zero values in computed health_score or are we missing components that the scorer expects?
Ravi S (cs): A few reps flagged accounts getting a "Low" status despite multiple good touchpoints. This looks like a scoring artifact, not a real churn signal.
Tara M (eng): I pulled production logs. The scorer service applies a default 0 when feature ingestion returns [] rather than null. Recent change in the feature API's filtering returned empty arrays for some metrics.
Nina K (cs-ops): Risk: playbook automation will fire "renewal-risk-nudge" for low scores. We should suppress that action for affected accounts until fixed and backfilled. Proposal: add a temporary playbook rule to ignore accounts where health_score == 0 AND metadata.source == "trial-import". Also run a backfill to recompute health_score for the cohort.
Eli P (data): Agreed. I can run a recompute job. Dry-run first: `scripts/recompute_scores.py --cohort 2024-10-28:2024-11-02 --dry-run --limit 1000`
Tara M (eng): I'll prepare a small hotfix to the scorer to treat empty arrays as null so they don't coerce to 0. PR will include unit test and a migration flag.
Ravi S (cs): For suppression, can we gate it to only apply to accounts with recent activity? We don't want to block nudges for truly inactive trials. Maybe `health_score == 0 && metadata.source == "trial-import" && last_activity >= -14d`.
Nina K (cs-ops): Good call. Maria can you craft the rule? (note: Maria is OOO but Ravi can copy)
Ravi S (cs): Adding rule via Console now:
```json
{
  "playbook": "renewal_risks_v2",
  "rules": [
    {
      "id": "suppress-zero-score-imports-2024-11",
      "condition": "health_score == 0 && metadata.source == \"trial-import\" && last_activity_days <= 14",
      "action": "suppress_action:renewal-risk-nudge",
      "expires_at": "2024-11-10T18:00:00Z",
      "notes": "Temporary suppression while data backfill/recompute runs"
    }
  ]
}
```
PlaybookBot: Playbook update accepted: suppress-zero-score-imports-2024-11 (applied by Ravi S). :white_check_mark:
Eli P (data): Dry-run recompute shows 72 accounts would change from 0 to values between 0.35-0.88. I'll run the apply in 10m: `scripts/recompute_scores.py --cohort 2024-10-28:2024-11-02 --apply --parallel 4`
Tara M (eng): PR created: https://git.company/repo/pull/4281 - change: treat empty feature arrays as NULL, add metric logging for empty->null transitions. Scheduling deploy in next deploy window.
Nina K (cs-ops): Action items: Eli run recompute and post results, Tara deploy scorer fix, Ravi monitor playbook suppression and notify CS reps not to manual-trigger nudges for that cohort. I'll create a short incident note and notify leads.
Eli P (data): Recompute applied: `recomputed:72, unchanged:8, errors:0` — posted updated list to the secure CS spreadsheet and removed those 72 from suppression as their score recomputed.
Ravi S (cs): Notified CS reps and added a quick playbook pause comment: "Paused for imported-zero-score cohort until recompute finishes".
Tara M (eng): Deployed scorer fix in canary, metrics look good, unit tests pass. Will promote to prod during the 2pm window.
PlaybookBot: Incident note created: INCIDENT-2024-11-zero-score-imports by Nina K.
Nina K (cs-ops): Thanks everyone. Closing thread — reopen if any downstream models show drift from this cohort. :thumbsup:
